final: WITH r AS (SELECT p.SEX AS s, AVG(1.0*l.CPK/l.GPT) AS a FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID=l.ID WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT<>0 GROUP BY p.SEX), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM r), k AS (SELECT a FROM r, m1 WHERE a>m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k), f AS (SELECT a FROM k, m2 WHERE a>m2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_remaining, AVG(a-(SELECT m FROM m1)) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(a-(SELECT m FROM m2)) AS avg_excess_second FROM f
